description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and Clock of Omens, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Cave Entrance room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and Staff of Domination, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Mine Tunnels room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, and create a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and the Food token, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Dark Pool room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and the Clue token, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Temple of Dumathoin room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to draw a card and complete Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Immovable Rod and the Treasure token, untapping Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, causing you to venture into the Cave Entrance room of Lost Mine of Phandelver, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificng an artifact token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
